setupSteps.text: Redirect the merchant to Shopify's authorization page to approve requested access scopes.
Validate the callback query parameters sent to your redirect URI.
Exchange the authorization code for an access token by sending a POST request to Shopify's token endpoint.
Include the access token in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header on Admin API requests.

tokenLifetime.notes: Expiring offline access tokens come with a refresh_token used to obtain a new access token.
